bonetool.known_sweep_footer: GetPedBoneIndex's own not-found return value is NOT confirmed against primary source -- every value above is raw. Run /k9bonetool goto <n> on anything promising and look with your own eyes before trusting it.
bonetool.known_sweep_header: K9 Bone Tool — known-name candidates (raw + UNFILTERED, read the last line):
bonetool.not_authorized: You are not authorized to use this tool.
bonetool.preview_bone_index:
Previewing bone index: %d
Looks right? Record it in config.lua: Config.PropAttachments.boneIndex (vest) or Config.FetchMechanic.mouthBoneIndex (fetch mouth carry).
Run /k9bonetool test to confirm with a real attach first.
bonetool.test_attached:
Test-attached at bone index %d.
Walk/turn around and, for a mouth-carry candidate, bark or pant to check for clipping before recording it.
bonetool.usage:
K9 Bone Sweep Tool -- DEV SERVER ONLY.
/k9bonetool goto <index>  -- preview one exact index (marker + on-screen label)
/k9bonetool next [step]   -- step the preview forward (default 1)
/k9bonetool prev [step]   -- step the preview backward (default 1)
/k9bonetool known         -- list candidate indices from known bone names (still verify with goto)
/k9bonetool test          -- really attach a marker prop at the current preview index
/k9bonetool stop          -- stop the preview and remove any test prop
Found the right index? Record it in config.lua:
  Config.PropAttachments.boneIndex (vest) or Config.FetchMechanic.mouthBoneIndex (fetch mouth carry).
